description: Keeps Ruby (.ruby-version), Node (.node-version), the gems, the npm packages
and the GitHub Actions at their latest release; the Docker base image follows
.ruby-version, which the Dockerfile takes as a build arg. Titles are
Conventional Commits, as release-please reads them on main: what ships in the
image (Ruby and the gems) is fix(deps), so it gets released, the actions

customManagers.description: Gemfile.lock's RUBY VERSION, moved with .ruby-version: a frozen bundle install refuses a lockfile naming another Ruby.

lockFileMaintenance.description: Waits for review: it can move a gem with no constraint in the Gemfile to a new major.

packageRules.description: Minor, patch and digest updates merge themselves once CI is green; a major waits for review.
RuboCop, its plugins and bundler-audit in their own PR, as chore(deps) since they don't ship: a new cop that flags the code, or a new audit check, then holds up only them.
.ruby-version and Gemfile.lock's RUBY VERSION in one PR.
The vendored Swagger UI release is updated by hand, all its files together.
Every action in one PR, kept pinned to a commit with its release in a comment.
A new Ruby or Node minor or major is its own PR to review; a patch merges itself.
